interface.request: same approved GEMM opcode, three bank IDs and 112-bit payload as scalar reference
interface.response: held done_valid/done_ready, operand0 tag, bank_count=3, all accepted bank IDs and error
interface.layout: activation [M,K] row-major; weight [n_tile,K] row-major; destination [m_count,n_total] row-major with n_start offset
interface.gemm_source_read_address: even 128-bit word address; each response is {word[a+1],word[a]}

architecture.array: 16x16 output-stationary BF16 systolic PEs; activation propagates right, weight down
architecture.dsp: one explicitly attributed and registered 8x8 BF16 significand multiplier per PE; post-synthesis DSP mapping must be verified
architecture.tile: up to 16 M x 16 N x 16 K; K tiled internally without ISA partial-sum commands
architecture.bank_feed: role-3 activation and role-4 weight banks each return one 256-bit pair per read; K16 aligned row segment uses one read, then private word buffers supply the wavefront
architecture.tails: M, N and K tails are masked, including unaligned row-major bank words
architecture.attention_modes: opcodes 6 and 8 share the 16x16 PE array, with 128-bit head-aware Q/K/P/V tile loading and V tile transposition; logical channels 3 and 5 retain separate bank roles and responses

numeric.input: BF16 including zero/subnormal; nonfinite inputs return error before writes from the affected M/N tile, while prior tiles may have written
numeric.multiply: exact BF16 significand product per PE
numeric.accumulate: K ascending, signed 32-bit shared-exponent mantissa with 4 guard bits; alignment shifts truncate magnitude toward zero
numeric.output: BF16 nearest-even; finite overflow yields infinity

verification.proof_scope: standalone XSIM and 200 MHz module OOC only; no fabric routing, placed/routed board, or Vitis execution
required_cases: real checkpoint BF16 q_proj prefill/decode values
K tails and full M32 N192 K576 command
aligned and unaligned K16 wide source reads
verification.attention_modes: XSIM full prefill32 and decode1 golden PASS; N=193/K=193 tile boundary PASS; integrated prefill32, focused one-key, and decode1 kv_len=33 two-chunk PASS; revised 100 MHz ZCU104 board routed WNS +1.475 ns, WHS +0.010 ns; physical board execution pending user
